verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own docs state that it can parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks, so inbound routing is a first-party capability. That is a single thin mention, though. It does not detail what rules can match on, which actions exist, or whether different rules can target different endpoints. The general webhook docs cover event notifications, not inbound-mail routing, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented recipient/pattern matching criteria, forward and store actions, per-rule POST to different endpoints, inbound routing API docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route inbound mail with rules — match on recipient or pattern and forward, store, or POST to different endpoints

citations.quote: Automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks.
